description: Boot-time clearance for a bot or agent: screens its system prompt and tool descriptions for injection, tool poisoning and embedded secrets, and returns a clearance_id (its SHA-256 audit receipt) to send as X-Caelara-Clearance on later calls. Optional (0.005 USDC per call)

agent.description: A label for the agent or bot (max 100 characters)

system_prompt.description: The agent system prompt or instructions (max 200000 characters)

tools.description: Tool names or { name, description } objects the agent will load (max 64)

name: shield_preflight
